name: Quickstart
summary: Light idea capture. The smallest agentic footprint: describe an idea, shape it, remember it — a PM + a coder + a venture mentor to coach the founder, almost no ceremony. /welcome runs first for new founders (v0.28). /prototype turns a rough idea into a runnable, clickable sketch fast — build-first as a legitimate lean-cycle start; the conscience helps fill the gaps after you see it, not before (v0.52, IDEA-030). /persona builds your app's target-user persona from the idea, grows it from what you know + research + dropped-in user research, and consults it as an agent voice — both to guide product decisions and to QA builds; a pre-filter that sharpens the questions you take to real users, never a replacement (v0.55, IDEA-031). /comprehend is AI-native scaffold tailoring (opt-in via `boss new --ai` / `boss adopt --ai`): reads what BOSS can understand (the idea / source / adopted repo), tailors the scaffold non-destructively, and seeds the venture brain with an honest first read so the conscience has continuity from day one — augments the deterministic template, never replaces it (v0.64, IDEA-022 Track 3). /decide records a load-bearing or hard-to-reverse choice as a durable DEC-NNN decision record (Context/Decision/Why/Consequences + who decided + how reversible) — the rationale future-you and a cofounder can read instead of guessing; slice 1 of the founder layer for teams (v0.74, IDEA-037/FEAT-021). /evidence gives evidence its own object — EVID-NNN, one signal per file, graded on a fixed 3-rung ladder (stated-pain → observed-behavior → commitment); the conscience reads the ledger and goes quieter when real commitments exist (v0.98, IDEA-045). /interview is the bridge from the conscience's advice ('a 15-minute call beats /canvas') to captured evidence — PREP a Mom-Test call as one printable page, then DEBRIEF pasted notes into honestly-graded EVID records, with a one-shot flag when you pitched instead of listened; BOSS never simulates the interview (v0.99, IDEA-046). /research digests a whole research transcript (interview recording, sales call, support thread) into graded EVID at scale + synthesized product context (pains/jobs/verbatim words/workarounds/objections → canvas + venture brain) and flags where the witness got led; analyzes what's there, never fabricates — the sibling of /interview at transcript scale (v0.100, IDEA-054). /sunset ends a project honestly — the post-mortem nobody ships: reads the canvas/ideas/devlog/EVID, walks the honest post-mortem (the bet, what evidence actually came in, what it taught) → the harvest (route reusable patterns UP via /boss-learn, write one-page docs/POSTMORTEM.md) → the clean close (`boss retire` → retired status; boss insights learns kill-speed, the Camuffo quit-faster metric). A real experiment that returned an answer, never failure; deliberate-invoke only, the conscience never suggests quitting unprompted; retiring ≠ deleting, and it's reversible (v0.103, IDEA-044).
graduationHint: When you're ready to actually build, switch to MVP mode: boss unlock mvp.
